name: Line and Paragraph Spacing
what_it_does: Sets the spacing between lines and before/after paragraphs.
behavior: Opens subfeature:line-spacing (dropdown). Contents (9 controls): 1.0, 1.15, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, Line Spacing Options…, Add Space Before Paragraph, Remove Space After Paragraph. Sub-surfaces: ui:line-spacing-menu-line-spacing-options. [the subfeature:line-spacing flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled] Appears as stacked lines with up/down arrows and a dropdown chevron.
